# <span id="aanchor156"></span> <span id="aanchor157"></span> Product Editor

The Products Editor allows users to set up the <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCTextPopup MCTextPopupHotSpot MCTextPopup_Open glossaryTerm MCTextPopupHotSpot_" alt="Closed" data-mc-alt2="Open">products<span class="MCTextPopupBody popupBody"><span class="MCTextPopupArrow"></span>Types of fluid being measured, such as crude oil, natural gasoline, or propane</span></a> that are to be measured in FLOWCAL. Setting up a product requires knowledge of which API table or calculation is to be used for calculating the correction for the temperature of the liquid (CTL) and the correction for the pressure of the liquid (CPL).

<div class="procedure">

To access the Product Editor:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **Liquids** section, select **Products**.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Setup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Setting up a Product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Setup">

<div class="procedure">

To set up a product:

1.  Launch the Product Editor and click **New**.

    A new product will be displayed in the product tree on the left of the form. You can expand the list to view the effective dates. Upon save of a newly created product, it will only have one time range for all of time, as shown above, and the dates cannot be edited while in New mode.

2.  Enter a product name and a product code. The product code is used to match a product in FLOWCAL to a product that is imported into FLOWCAL. These fields are required and the values must be unique.

3.  Click the button next to the Color label to select a color for the product.

    The color specified is displayed in the Volume Editor, on the Ticket Editor grid, and in the Ticket Search grid. Using different colors for different products makes it easier to see a change in product on multi-product screens.

4.  Configure additional settings as appropriate under the 6 tabs in the Product Editor.

5.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Editing">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Editing a Product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Editing">

The Product Editor also provides several other functional settings for products. These additional functions are available in the form area to the right of the Product Tree, organized by tabs.

The date-effective options are available when the user selects a datetime effective range from the product tree.

<div class="procedure">

To edit a product:

1.  Select a product name and the date range of interest for the product from the tree view.

2.  Click **Edit**.

    Only saved products may be edited. Only products that are not associated with another item, such as a meter, a source, or a ticket, may be deleted.

3.  The **From** and **To** date fields become editable as well as the characteristics for the product. Enter the required information.

4.  Enter an effective date range and specifies the characteristics for the time range entered.

5.  If necessary, configure additional settings under the **Validations** and **Discrimination** tabs.

6.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

</div>
